releaseNotes: Release v37 - Version 5.9: Sprint 8 completed. Delivered zero-sign-in standalone productivity engine (TaskEntity, TaskDao) with TickTick-depth task categorization (Inbox, Work, Personal, Errands), priorities (P1-P4), on-device deterministic NLP conversational parser (TaskNlpParser), two-way CalendarProvider bridge, and full Jetpack Compose ProductivityScreen.
